Description: Low-traffic direct HTTPS demo network: one subnet and Internet Gateway, no NAT Gateway, load balancer or CloudFront. Host and retained data are separate.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: public IPv4 -> single EC2 HTTPS proxy; direct outbound HTTPS through an Internet Gateway
must: No NAT Gateway, paid VPC endpoints or load balancer.
Supply an RFC1918 VPC CIDR containing the subnet CIDR; select one explicit AZ.
Only the separate host stack may enable web ingress; administration stays SSM-only.
These templates are for a fresh demo, not an in-place migration of the older private topology.

VpcCidr.ConstraintDescription: Enter a valid RFC1918 IPv4 CIDR with a prefix from /16 through /28.
VpcCidr.Description: Explicit RFC1918 VPC CIDR containing PublicSubnetCidr.

PublicSubnetCidr.ConstraintDescription: Enter a valid RFC1918 IPv4 CIDR with a prefix from /16 through /28.
PublicSubnetCidr.Description: Explicit subnet CIDR inside VpcCidr. Subnet-wide public address assignment remains disabled; the host stack owns one Elastic IP.

AvailabilityZone.Description: Explicit AZ shared by the host and separately retained data volume.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Isolates the small-demo host within one explicit network boundary.
Places the host on a direct internet route without a NAT Gateway.
Provides the direct public HTTPS and outbound HTTPS network path.
Connects this VPC to its sole Internet Gateway.
Holds the direct internet route for the host subnet.
Routes IPv4 traffic directly to the Internet Gateway; SG controls permitted traffic.
Applies the internet route to the host subnet.

HostSubnetId.Description: SubnetId for demo-host.template.json, not the private CloudFront host.
